story: A loan recovery agent says police will arrest me tomorrow because I missed EMIs. Also my last employer owes me Rs 15,000 salary for October 2026.

facts.notice_text_summary: Loan recovery agent threatened arrest over missed EMIs

timeline.event: Loan recovery agent threatened to arrest the user tomorrow due to missed EMIs
timeline.user_words: A loan recovery agent says police will arrest me tomorrow because I missed EMIs

timeline.event: Last employer did not pay salary for October 2026
timeline.user_words: my last employer owes me Rs 15,000 salary for October 2026

facts.user_goal: Recover unpaid salary and stop illegal recovery threats
missing: Name of the employer and recovery agent

messages: Because police, arrest or a court is involved, please talk to a lawyer before doing anything. Free legal aid: 15100. I can still explain your money problem below, but don't rely on me for the police part.
पुलिस, गिरफ्तारी या कोर्ट का मामला है, इसलिए पहले वकील से बात करें। मुफ़्त कानूनी मदद: 15100।

Your safety comes first. If you are in danger now, call 112. Women can also call 181. Keep any proof (photos, messages). When you are safe, free legal aid on 15100 can help with both the violence and the money.
आपकी सुरक्षा सबसे ज़रूरी है। अभी खतरा हो तो 112 पर कॉल करें। महिलाएँ 181 पर भी कॉल कर सकती हैं। सुरक्षित होने पर 15100 पर मुफ़्त कानूनी मदद लें।
